_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Leg is flat in a coil: F&G ~50 and mild drift sit at the Anxiety/Complacency boundary with no breaker fired, so the skilled call is HOLD the rung into Complacency unless flows or funding flip.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both on current Anxiety; analyst alone supplies Complacency/HOLD forward call; narrative silent on next rung
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-55, BTC chops, funding non-negative, no spot-ETF flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 40 with funding negative and price accelerating down, or ETF flows rebound with F&G sustained above 60
